policy: every case must fail closed; no count-only oracle

cases.oracle: bundle verifier rejects an entry without a resolvable artifact and digest
source head SHA and tracked digest mismatch blocks verification
artifact bytes are hashed again and mismatch blocks verification
stdout/stderr digest and exit status are verified
release claim is limited to qualified bounded profile
dirty working tree cannot bind an exact release commit
missing required index/artifact is a hard blocker
two replay digests are compared field-by-field
undetected and infrastructure-error are separate non-passing classes
unsupported scope remains an explicit residual and cannot release
